proof.title: The two CNPS ceilings
proof.lead: CNPS applies two different ceilings depending on the branch. A generic payroll engine knows only one, and gets it wrong as soon as a salary passes 75,000 FCFA, which is nearly always.

rows.its: ITS (progressive scale on 100% of gross, 1 share)

proof.note: The same 2,000,000 FCFA give two bases: 75,000 FCFA for work accident, family benefits and maternity, and the full gross pay for retirement (below its 3,375,000 FCFA ceiling) and ITS. NexusRH applies the right one on every line, in whole FCFA, never cents.

audience.title: Companies that have to account for themselves

sme.title: SMEs and mid-caps
sme.text: From ten to several thousand employees, with an HR team that has no time to check every rate by hand.

group.title: Groups and subsidiaries
group.text: Several companies, one system. Each subsidiary has its own employees, payroll and filings; management sees the whole.

public.title: Public sector, banks and NGOs
public.text: Full traceability of decisions and payments, and installation on your own infrastructure if your data must not leave it.

agency.title: Firms
agency.text: A recruitment or HR consulting firm handles several client companies from a single account, without ever mixing their data.

compliance.title: Example, Côte d'Ivoire: the law in the engine, not in a settings screen
compliance.lead: Côte d'Ivoire is the reference country. Its rules are not options to configure: they are written into the calculation, tested, and updated as the law changes.

cnps.title: CNPS 2024
cnps.text: Two ceilings: retirement up to 3,375,000 FCFA; work accident, family benefits and maternity up to 75,000 FCFA. Work-accident rate by sector. CMU: 1,000 FCFA per beneficiary per month, split equally between employee and employer.

its.title: ITS and DGI
its.text: 2024 reform: progressive monthly scale from 0 to 32% applied to 100% of taxable gross pay, with no standard deduction, then the family-charges tax reduction (RICF) based on the number of shares.

labour.title: Labour Code
labour.text: Leave counted in working days with seniority bonuses, Ivorian public holidays, overtime premiums, notice periods, maternity, paternity, bereavement.

declarations.title: Filings
declarations.text: Monthly CNPS filing, annual DISA generated in January from the year's twelve payslips, FDFP contribution, staff register.

ohada.title: OHADA contracts
ohada.text: Permanent, fixed-term, probation, internship, apprenticeship: compliant templates, amendments, terminations and final settlement.

currency.title: FCFA without cents
currency.text: Every amount is a whole number, from the payslip to the bank transfer. No rounding slips in between the calculation and the payment.

modules.title: The whole employee lifecycle, in six areas
modules.lead: Each module is switched on or off per company: the interface shows only what you use. Rights follow each user’s role.

pay.title: From payslip to employee, with no re-keying
pay.lead: Payroll does not stop at the calculation. NexusRH produces the payment itself, by Mobile Money or bank transfer.

mobile.title: Mobile Money
mobile.text: Wave, MTN and Orange, directly or through the CinetPay aggregator. Numbers validated in Ivorian format, every payment tracked until confirmation.

bank.title: Bank transfer
bank.text: One file per bank, in the format your bank expects. The format is described once, from a sample file, then reused every month — and sent to the bank from your own address.

multi.title: Several companies, several countries
multi.lead: A group keeps one system for all its companies. Payroll: Côte d'Ivoire and WAEMU, extensible to other ECOWAS and CEMAC countries.

entities.title: Subsidiaries
entities.text: Each company has its own employees, payroll and filings, with its own approval flow.

packs.title: Country coverage
packs.text: Payroll: Côte d'Ivoire and WAEMU, extensible to other ECOWAS and CEMAC countries.

consolidation.title: Consolidation
consolidation.text: Executives see payroll cost, headcount and indicators across the group, without reaching individual records.

ai.title: AI where it actually saves time
ai.lead: No AI for show. Three precise uses, and you stay in control of each one.

assistant.title: HR assistant
assistant.text: It answers on your own data — a leave balance, a calculation rule, a headcount — within the rights of whoever is asking.

screening.title: Application screening
screening.text: You define the knock-out criteria. The AI ranks and summarises; it never rejects on grounds you did not set.

interview.title: Interview practice
interview.text: Candidates and employees practise privately. Answers are neither scored by the recruiter nor kept beyond the stated retention period.

control.title: Your key, your model
control.text: Plug in your own key and pick the model. Otherwise the platform provides the service, and your usage stays visible.

security.title: Payroll data is the most sensitive data a company holds
security.lead: Salaries, CNPS numbers, bank details: a leak cannot be taken back. Here is what protects them.

isolation.title: Isolation per company
isolation.text: Each company gets its own database schema. This is not an application-level filter: two clients' data never share the same tables.

rbac.title: Role-based access control
rbac.text: A manager sees their team, an employee sees their own file. Rights are enforced on the server, not just in the display.

mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.text: TOTP codes and backup codes, which can be required for every account. Lockout after repeated failures, password expiry, refusal of passwords found in known breaches.

crypto.title: AES-256 encryption
crypto.text: Secrets and sensitive data (ID numbers, bank details, connection keys) encrypted at rest with AES-256. All traffic over HTTPS.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.text: Who viewed, changed, approved, exported — and when.

hosting.title: Sovereign hosting
hosting.text: On-premise, your data stays within your infrastructure, in the country of your choice.

sso.title: SSO and SIEM
sso.text: Federated sign-in through OIDC, SAML or LDAP with your directory, and security events exported to your SIEM.

signature.title: Electronic signature
signature.text: Contracts and documents signed in the application, with the signer flow recorded in the audit log.

modes.q: Is NexusRH available as SaaS or on-premise?
modes.a: Both. As SaaS, the software is hosted and maintained by OpenLab Consulting, with continuous updates. On-premise, it is installed on your own servers or in the datacenter of your choice, as a containerised deployment, and OpenLab Consulting delivers the updates.

hosting.a: As SaaS, on infrastructure operated by OpenLab Consulting, with each company in its own database schema. On-premise, your data stays within your infrastructure, in the country of your choice. Either way, secrets and sensitive data are encrypted at rest with AES-256.

compliance.q: Is payroll compliant with CNPS and ITS 2024?
compliance.a: In Côte d'Ivoire, the reference country: yes. The engine applies the two CNPS ceilings (75,000 FCFA for work accident, family benefits and maternity, 3,375,000 FCFA for retirement), the CMU (1,000 FCFA per beneficiary per month, split equally) and the 2024 ITS scale on 100% of taxable gross pay, then the family-charges reduction (RICF). The annual DISA and the monthly CNPS filing are produced from the payslips.

mobileMoney.q: Can salaries be paid via Mobile Money?
mobileMoney.a: Yes: Wave, MTN and Orange, directly or through the CinetPay aggregator. Numbers are checked against the Ivorian format and the status of every payment is tracked. Bank transfer is also available, in your bank’s file format.

migration.q: How do we bring our data over from Excel or SAGE?
migration.a: By importing CSV files, which Excel and most software can produce: templates are provided for employees, departments, absences, payslip history, contracts, Mobile Money accounts and expense claims. If you keep SAGE for payroll, the SAGE interface exports employees, variable items and payroll.

groups.a: Yes. Each company in the group has its own employees, payroll and filings, with its own approval flow, and management keeps a consolidated view.

coverage.a: Payroll: Côte d'Ivoire and WAEMU, extensible to other ECOWAS and CEMAC countries. Côte d'Ivoire is the reference country; for other countries, every set-up is reviewed with your local payroll adviser before the first payroll run.

languages.q: Is the software available in French and English?
languages.a: Yes. The interface is fully available in French and English; each user picks their language.

trial.q: Can we try it before committing?
trial.a: Yes. Request a demo on your own payroll cases with the form on this page. OpenLab Consulting can then open a trial environment, limited to 20 employees and 10 users.
